dict.string: Oatmeal records your microphone locally to transcribe your meetings. Audio never leaves your machine.
Oatmeal captures system audio locally to transcribe what other participants say. Nothing is streamed off your machine.
Oatmeal reads your calendar to show what's coming up and to title your meeting notes. Nothing is written back and nothing leaves your machine.
